verdict.rationale: Adyen documents managing the full ACP and UCP checkout flows for agent platforms: creating checkout sessions with totals and fulfillment options, tokenizing shopper credentials into delegated ACP/UCP tokens tied to the session and merchant, and orchestrating stock, tax, shipping and payment authorization through to a completed transaction. missing for 10: explicit documentation of the order-confirmation step returned to the agent (only implied via payment authorization and the optional commit session), independent or hands-on corroboration of an end-to-end agent purchase.
